name: Cerim Leiado
source:
Likes: Quiet place
Dislikes: Nosy people
Hobby: To search about different kingdoms
Skill: Offensive magic

"Come on... at least let me act like your knight."

Elias: Cerim is a serious student with a great personality, who constantly achieves high grades.
But strangely, he only attends in morning classes.
Of course, he is far from Luca.
So there's no way he skips classes.
But I wonder why...
His last name, Leiado, it sounds familiar... Hmm...

[Official in-game description]
